race.description: Racing @ Pinjarra Park Thurs August 20 Hcp (C3)
race.comment: SURROUND ME (6) finished off nicely to be 2.5L off the winner at Bunbury when first-up, finishing behind a subsequent Saturday winner in Cinque Stelle. Pike now reunites with her and the inside draw should see her get every chance. She looks set to return to winning form. SWANSEE (9) is hard to knock on her recent form, jumping favourite over Cinque Stelle last start before finishing 2.5L away. Her form prior was solid at this level and despite the wide draw, she can work across with her early speed. Can repeat the dose. THE NUN (7) has been readied with a trial coming into this with O'Donnell sticking from that trial. She's a first-up winner last campaign and was tested in Listed grade. Can return in good order. CENTRE BOND (1) has trialled nicely coming in and can feature on resumption back to the midweeks. ROAMING AMERICA (3) was solid on resumption and can build on that effort back to this level.
